WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.zonelabel,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CAST(m.facetresmm AS REAL) / CAST(m.geomdeltamm AS REAL)) as site_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) as mesh_count
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanmesh m ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
  WHERE m.facetresmm IS NOT NULL 
    AND m.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND m.geomdeltamm != 0
    AND s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_ratio) as status_avg
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
)
SELECT 
  sr.insurstat,
  AVG(sr.site_ratio) as above_avg_sites_average_ratio,
  COUNT(sr.zoneregistry) as above_avg_sites_count,
  AVG(sr.site_ratio - sa.status_avg) as avg_excess_over_status
FROM site_ratios sr
JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_avg
GROUP BY sr.insurstat
